findings.claim: The current-attempt-pinning behavior was not delivered.
findings.observed: The supplied plan, implementation checkpoint, and task-scoped diff state that no authenticated KM draft-dispatch ingress, immutable attempt envelope path, or canonical draft-result recorder exists in this checkout; production Deliberation continuation code was not added.
findings.rationale: Goal-001 requires the owner-authenticated ingress to validate and atomically propagate a complete immutable attempt envelope, plus pre-side-effect stale/duplicate fencing at payload reads and result recording. With those required owner surfaces absent, the behavior cannot be delivered safely.
findings.required: Deliver the accepted KM-owner draft-dispatch and result-recorder contract, mirror it in the Deliberation contract provenance, and implement the owner-selected ingress with envelope validation, active-envelope replacement, and stale/duplicate fencing before side effects.
